First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:45 pm. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Not too fast, regroups at water stops. It’s no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That’s the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Monday Nights at Arcadia Trails group ride

Monday Nights at Arcadia Trails is a mountain bike group ride in Edmond, OK. It rolls every Monday at 6:45 pm from Post Road parking lot, under the Edmond water tower (northeast side of Arcadia Lake).

A Monday night mountain bike ride on the Arcadia Lake trails. All levels welcome, regroups at the water stops, and the group splits in two if needed. Helmets required, lights recommended.
